title: 第18章 通灵宝第19章 可怜的小白
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 众人目送赵归涯飘走后，纷纷低头研究起手中的通灵宝。
楚安芷手中的是一枚青玉令牌，注入灵力后，令牌表面浮现出淡淡的光晕。
“滴血认主……”
她咬破指尖，一滴鲜血落在令牌上。
顿时，一股奇异的感觉涌上心头，仿佛与这枚令牌建立了某种联系。
令牌在她手中渐渐变形，最终化作一枚精致的银镯。
楚安芷将银镯戴在腕上，立刻感觉到无数信息涌入脑海。
加入仙门论坛和加仙友的指南。
“一直想拥有通灵宝，可惜一直没钱。”
柳清漪兴奋地叫道，她的通灵宝已经变成了一枚耳坠，“现在终于拥有自己的了。”
楚安芷轻抚手腕上的银镯，感受着通灵宝传来的信息流。
她尝试着将神识探入其中，眼前立刻浮现出一片浩瀚的信息海洋。
仙门论坛的各个板块、热门话题、甚至还有实时交流的传音区。
「欢迎新仙友加入仙门论坛！
」一行金色文字在她神识中浮现，「请输入您的道号...」
楚安芷想了想，输入「安知非我命」。
「道号已确认！
安知非我命道友，您目前的权限为：初入仙门。
随着修为提升和论坛贡献增加，权限将逐步开放。
她好奇地浏览着各个板块：「修仙交流」、「功法探讨」、「秘境探险」、「奇物交易」...每个板块下还有无数子分类，信息量庞大得令人咋舌。
欧阳叙白看大家都和自己的通灵宝绑定之后，举起自己戒指形态的通灵宝。
“来来来，碰一碰，加一个仙友，我给你们拉个群。”
众人纷纷将通灵宝凑到一起，随着一阵灵光闪烁，彼此之间建立了联系。
欧阳叙白迅速创建了一个名为「观世宗一家人」的群组。
「拒做牛马未」：嚯，那么快就把群都建好了，这群名谁取的？
「浪里白龙第一帅」：嘿嘿，我取的，怎么样？
「拒做牛马未」：……和你名字一样，土得掉渣。
「安知非我命」：你俩名字谁也别说谁。
「拒做牛马未」：我把研武大会的资料我已经整理好传到你们通灵宝了。
「破暝座下柳」：小未，你这办事效率够高的。
「拒做牛马未」：那你们先看我先下线了。
「叶落财来」：小未，你先去忙吧。
大家迫不及待地查看传过来的资料，里面详细记录着历届研武大会的赛制、参赛人员特点以及奖励情况。
楚安芷的神识沉浸在通灵宝中，赵归涯整理的资料极为详尽，甚至包含了各门派可能参赛的参赛选手的功法特点和弱点分析。
“这……这也太全面了吧？”
柳清漪瞪大眼睛，“连赤焰宗那个墨黎安喜欢先出左手的习惯都记下来了！”
封无痕摸着下巴：“小未这小子，太强了吧”
叶知秋突然皱眉：“等等，这份资料里怎么还有欲宗参赛选手的详细分析？”
众人一愣，这才注意到资料中确实包含了欲宗弟子的信息，而且比其他门派的更加详尽，连一些压箱底的绝招都记录在案。
欧阳叙白干笑两声：“那个……小舅他……嗯……比较公正？”
分明就是想赢。
一旁没出声的柳清晏咦了一声，“小未发了那么多近百年秘境变化的分布图，图下面的那些奇奇怪怪的符号是什么？”
content_en:
After everyone watched Zhao Guiya float away, they all lowered their heads and studied the psychic treasure in their hands.
What Chu Anzhi held was a sapphire token. After injecting spiritual power, a faint halo appeared on the surface of the token.
"Recognize the Lord by shedding blood..."
She bit her fingertip and a drop of blood fell on the token.
Suddenly, a strange feeling came to my heart, as if I had established some kind of connection with this token.
The token gradually deformed in her hand, and finally turned into an exquisite silver bracelet.
Chu Anzhi put the silver bracelet on her wrist and immediately felt countless information pouring into her mind.
A guide to joining the Immortal Forum and adding Immortal Friends.
"I've always wanted to own a psychic treasure, but unfortunately I never had the money."
Liu Qingyi shouted excitedly, her psychic treasure had turned into an earring, "Now I finally have my own."
Chu Anzhi stroked the silver bracelet on her wrist, feeling the flow of information from the psychic treasure.
She tried to put her consciousness into it, and a vast ocean of information immediately appeared in front of her eyes.
The Xianmen Forum has various sections, hot topics, and even a sound transmission area for real-time communication.
"Welcome new immortal friends to join the Xianmen Forum!
"A line of golden text appeared in her consciousness, "Please enter your Taoist number..."
Chu Anzhi thought for a while and entered "An Zhi is not my life".
"The road number has been confirmed!
Dear fellow Taoist An Zhifei, your current permissions are: first entering the Immortal Sect.
As the cultivation level increases and the forum contribution increases, the permissions will be gradually opened.
She curiously browsed through the various sections: "Exchanges on Immortal Cultivation", "Exploration of Cultivation Techniques", "Exploration in Secret Realms", "Trading of Strange Objects"... There are countless sub-categories under each section, and the amount of information is staggering.
After Ouyang Xubai saw that everyone was bound to their own psychic treasures, he raised his own psychic treasure in the form of a ring.
"Come on, come on, let's touch each other, add a fairy friend, and I'll create a group for you."
Everyone gathered their psychic treasures together, and with a flash of spiritual light, they established a connection with each other.
Ouyang Xubai quickly created a group called "Guanshizong Family".
"Refuse to be a cow and a horse": Oh, the group was established so quickly. Who named the group?
"The most handsome white dragon in the waves": Hehe, I took it, how do you like it?
"Refuse to be a cow and a horse": ...just like your name, the dirt will fall off.
"It's not my fate to be safe": Don't say the names of either of you.
"Refuse to be a bully": I have sorted out the information about the martial arts conference and sent it to your psychic treasure.
"Po Ming sits under Liu": Xiao Wei, you are very efficient in doing things.
"Refuse to be a bully": Then you guys need to watch me first and I will log off.
"Ye Luocai Lai": Xiao Wei, go ahead and do your work.
Everyone can't wait to check the information passed in, which contains detailed records of the competition system, characteristics of the participants, and rewards of previous martial arts competitions.
Chu Anzhi's consciousness was immersed in the psychic treasure. The information compiled by Zhao Guiya was extremely detailed and even included an analysis of the skills and weaknesses of potential contestants from each sect.
"This...isn't this too comprehensive?"
Liu Qingyi's eyes widened, "I even remembered the habit of Mo Li'an from the Scarlet Flame Sect who likes to use his left hand first!"
Feng Wuhen touched his chin: "This kid Xiaowei is too strong."
Ye Zhiqiu suddenly frowned: "Wait a minute, why is there a detailed analysis of Yuzong's contestants in this information?"
Everyone was stunned for a moment, and then they noticed that the information did contain information about Yu Sect disciples, and it was more detailed than other sects. Even some of the secret tricks were recorded.
Ouyang Xubai laughed dryly: "That... uncle, he is... um... more fair?"
Obviously he just wants to win.
"Huh?"
Liu Qingyan, who was silent on the side, let out a sigh, "Xiaowei has posted so many distribution maps of the changes in the secret realm in the past hundred years. What are those strange symbols under the pictures?"
